name: Sharmin Sultana
title: PhD Student in Computer Science
tagline: Healthcare-focused AI research and applied NLP
summary: I am a PhD student in Computer Science at the University of Massachusetts Lowell, specializing in healthcare-focused artificial intelligence and natural language processing. My research focuses on developing, fine-tuning, and deploying machine learning, transformer-based models, and large language models for analyzing clinical and biomedical data, particularly electronic health records (EHRs) and social determinants of health. Currently, I work as a Research Assistant in the UMass BioNLP Lab under Prof. Hong Yu, where my work explores opioid use disorder, overdose risk, and medication initiation among justice-involved U.S. veterans.
